data.name: Kamranah
data.gender_notes: Kamranah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kamranah is derived from the Arabic root word 'kamara' which means 'to serve'. This name signifies a deep commitment and devotion to Allah. The name Kamranah carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamranah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires a life dedicated to Allah.
data.etymology: Kamranah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamranah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كمرانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: كمرانة هي اسم يعكس الجمال والكمال والنعمة، مشتق من الجذر العربي كمر، الذي يعني الكمال والزهرة، وتستخدم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الشخص المتكامل والكامل

in_urdu.name: کمرنہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: کمرنہ ایک نام ہے جو خوبصورتی اور کمال اور نعمت کی عکاسی کرتا ہے، جو عربي gốc کمر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کمال اور زهرہ کو bedeut کرتا ہے، اور اسلامي روایت میں مکمل اور کامل شخص کی وضاحت کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: कम्रनह
